effects: The signer sends `amount` of SPK (the vault collateral 0xc200…b066) to the vault through transferFrom, which uses the signer's existing SPK allowance to the vault.
The vault mints stSPK shares to `onBehalfOf`, at a count computed from the current active stake and shares.
The deposit becomes slashable stake of `onBehalfOf` in the vault.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 SPK into the vault, with the vault address and the beneficiary that gets the deposit.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many stSPK shares the beneficiary receives; the count comes from vault state.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` and `_activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.onBehalfOf`.
findings.fix: None possible: the share count depends on activeStake and activeShares in storage.

effects: The vault burns the signer's stSPK shares worth `amount` of SPK, rounded up (previewWithdraw).
The vault moves `amount` SPK from active stake into the withdrawal queue of the next epoch.
The vault gives `claimer` the withdrawal shares, so only `claimer` can claim the SPK after the next epoch ends.
Queued SPK stays slashable until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 SPK for the claim owner, with the vault address.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the stSPK shares burned from the signer; the count comes from vault state.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` then `_activeSharesOf[msg.sender].push(..., activeSharesOf(msg.sender) - burnedShares)`. The descriptor shows only `Requested assets` and `Claim owner`.
findings.fix: None possible: the burn depends on storage values.

findings.title: withdraw does not say the SPK is claimable only after the next epoch, and stays slashable until then.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; ... withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares;` and _claim: `if (epoch >= currentEpoch()) revert InvalidEpoch();`. The intent is "Request withdrawal".
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to "Request delayed SPK withdrawal".

effects: The vault burns `shares` stSPK from the signer.
The vault moves the SPK value of those shares, computed from vault state, into the withdrawal queue of the next epoch.
The vault gives `claimer` the withdrawal shares, so only `claimer` can claim the SPK after the next epoch ends.
formats.shown: Queue 0.987654321123456789 stSPK for the claim owner, with the vault address.

findings.title: redeem does not show the SPK amount queued for the claim owner; it comes from vault state.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());`. The descriptor shows `Vault shares` with `tokenPath: @.to` only.
findings.fix: None possible: the SPK amount depends on storage values.

findings.title: redeem intent "Queue share withdrawal" does not say the signer's stSPK is burned for SPK.
findings.evidence: Descriptor redeem intent "Queue share withdrawal"; VaultTokenized._withdraw emits `Transfer(msg.sender, address(0), burnedShares)`.
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to "Redeem stSPK for queued SPK withdrawal".

effects: The vault marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
The vault sends the signer's SPK withdrawal amount for `epoch`, computed from storage, to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal of epoch 42 to the recipient, with the vault address; no token and no amount.

findings.title: claim does not show the SPK amount sent to the recipient, and the intent does not name SPK.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `amount = _claim(epoch); IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` with `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)` from storage. Descriptor intent "Claim withdrawal".
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to "Claim SPK withdrawal"; the amount cannot be shown.

effects: The vault marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
The vault sends the sum of the signer's SPK withdrawal amounts for those epochs, computed from storage, to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals of epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient, with each epoch listed and the vault address; no token and no amount.

findings.title: claimBatch does not show the total SPK sent to the recipient, and the intent does not name SPK.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);` then `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. Descriptor intent "Claim withdrawals".
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to "Claim SPK withdrawals"; the amount cannot be shown.
